int bonus(int base) {
int x = 0;
if(base > 2000)
x = 3000;
else if(base > 1000)
x = 2000;
else
x = 1000;
return x;
}

int calculate(int x, int y) {
while(x != y) {
if(x > y)
x -= y;
else
y -= x;
}
return x;
}
